messages.body: DIRECTIVE 67009 ROUTED: routed to build lanes: BEB-6791, BEB-9173 (parked/held requeued); the loop claims them on the tick.

[CC not fable, BEB-9150] m67009 answered from the attempts schema (dispatcher src CREATE :790 + the INSERT :2925 — the columns are the ground truth). An attempt row does NOT carry enough to hash the input. Stored: ticket, node, step, outcome, error, artefact, at, attempt, path, reason_code, expected, actual, prompt_head, input_changed. The only input-ish fields are prompt_head (a TRUNCATED head, not the full prompt) and input_changed (a 0/1 flag from comparing this head to the previous head, :2922). MISSING: spec ref, base sha, config, full prompt. So there is nothing to build a real INPUT comparator over — 9173 (capture spec_ref + full prompt hash + base_sha + config onto the attempt row at write) comes BEFORE 6791. Do not build the comparator over fields that do not exist — that is your own guardrail and it applies here. Note: a crude input_changed already exists (head-only), so 9173 is an ADDITIVE upgrade of an existing signal, not a new table. Separately: BEB-9171 landed+proven (goal weight reaches queue, dispatcher 65fdf5ba) and I re-asserted the BB Docs chain as a w10 goal — 2495/9155/9154/9159 now rank weight-10 in would_claim, 9168 weight-10 behind the concurrency cap; the loop drains the chain in checker-first order as its 15 in-flight lanes free.
